context.description: A spec that stops validating during a run is reported and the run keeps its plan

evidence.trustReason: Fresh-context review of packages/opencode/test/task/verify-spec-VF4.spec.ts (2 tests, titles [VF4]); my own bun test run: 2 pass, 0 fail, 31 expect() calls, 6.6 s. GIVEN a live run of a valid spec: a real /task job on a committed release-notes copy (T1.1 and T1.2 after the outside T9) that the loader validates with no failure; the real run supervisor with its real 1 s stale cadence and stale-check worker, the real Recorder and status writer; the test polls until status.json is live, with no warning and no stored spec.checked. WHEN a VERIFY.md is edited: T1.3 VERIFY.md in the root checkout gets two unknown categories and a changed c1 text; the loader gives exactly two R3 failures at that path (I checked that the replace patterns match the committed file). THEN the run keeps working on the plan it loaded: the run supervisor's live snapshot spec is equal before and after, T1.3.c1 keeps its old text, status.json keeps the same task and obligation ids, the lease still names the run, and after /task trust T9 the run records outside.trusted T9 and task.started for T1.1 and T1.2, with no run.ended, no run.cancelled and no obligation.stale. AND the stale check records spec.checked with the failures and a history entry: exactly one stored spec.checked whose failures equal the two loader lines, and exactly one run history entry 'spec.checked: 2 failures' in status.json; the run stays live with no reason. AND the status run warning: run.warning split by newline equals the two loader lines in order. On the writer's note that the test does not observe which actor records spec.checked: the step names the stale check as the source, and the test observes no spec.checked before the edit and one after. I checked src/task by text search: the only producer of spec.checked is TaskWorkers.staleCheck (workers.ts), invoked by the run supervisor's staleCadence 'stale' actor, and the test overrides no actor, so the stored fact can only come from the stale check. The worker-versus-supervisor detail of defect 8 is internal; the T3.3 unit test in supervise-run.test.ts covers the spec.checked-before-obligation.stale order. Not a gap for this scenario.
